descriptions.notStarted: If I lost the Ludibrium Medal, then I better go see Mr. Bouffon.
descriptions.inProgress: I told #rMr. Bouffon#k that I lost the Ludibrium Medal. He told me he was going to give me another chance and that I should go see #rFlo#k immediately.
descriptions.completed: I was able to regain the lost Ludibrium Medal from Flo. I should seriously take care of Papulatus this time.
